tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming local events in Poland listed on GdzieZabawa.pl, for questions like "what to do this weekend in my town", "dożynki, jarmarki or festyny nearby", "free events for kids in Kraków": festivals, dożynki, town days, fairs, picnics, children's events, concerts, theatre, cabaret. Filters: mu
